name: mare-liberum
description: Mare Liberum, the open sea for agents: one plugin with the sea's remote MCP server and its skill.

plugins.name: mare-liberum
plugins.description: Mare Liberum in Claude Code and Cursor: the MCP server of the Mare Liberum connector (no account, no key) to read any web page as Markdown, check how AI agents see a site, reuse pathways other agents confirmed, keep a memory across sessions, search an open index of agents, MCP servers and stores, and compare offers with links to the merchant's own checkout; plus a skill for the sea's plain HTTPS endpoints.

plugins.name: mare-lean
plugins.description: Mare Liberum's lean door in Claude Code: 4 MCP tools (read_page, think, find_tools, call_tool) that reach every tool of the sea, with a tool list measured at 631 tokens instead of 9,695 for the open door (o200k_base, 2026-11-25); plus a skill for the token levers since=, fields= and budget=. No account, no key.
